definitions.explanation: A situation where one person handles work or tasks that typically require multiple people, originally from restaurant industry terminology.

definitions.gloss: solo parenting; single-handedly caring for children
definitions.explanation: When one parent handles all childcare duties alone, without help from a partner.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of ワンオペレーション (one operation), from English "one operation."

ORIGIN:
Originated in the fast-food industry to describe shifts where only one employee works. The term gained wider use after media coverage of overwork issues at chain restaurants.

USAGE:
・ワンオペ + noun: ワンオペ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧ (solo parenting), ワンオペ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (one-person sales)
・ワンオペ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ single-handedly)
・ワンオペ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (one-person operation state)

SOCIAL CONTEXT:
The term ワンオペ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧ became popular in discussions about working mothers who bear the burden of childcare alone while their partners work long hours. It highlights issues of work-life balance and unequal division of household labor in Japan.

SIMILAR TERMS:
・⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ - to run (something) by oneself
・⟦{孤軍奮闘|こぐんふんとう}→孤軍奮闘：30303_kogunfuntou⟧ - fighting alone against the odds
